wfm_payload.user_original_input: If a man is taller than another man, the taller one can block the other's shooting. Michael is a man who is taller than everyone else in his class. If person x is taller than person y, and person y is taller than person z, then x is taller than z. Peter is a man who is taller than Michael. Michael can block any shooting from a person as long as the person does not jump when shooting. Michael cannot block Windy's shooting. Every shooter who can jump when shooting is a great shooter. In conclusion: Peter is shorter than a man in Michael's class.
